caption: The drawing depicts a single, detailed object: a goblet or chalice with a wide, shallow bowl and a sturdy stem on a round base. The bowl of the goblet features a repeated raised circular or oval pattern, resembling bubbles or convex lenses, covering its entire surface. The stem is relatively short, flares outward in the middle, and is decorated with elongated vertical fluting that extends downward to a round, ribbed base. The entire object is rendered in grayscale, with careful shading to indicate its three-dimensional form and the reflective qualities of its material. The goblet is centered within a faint rectangular border on a plain, lightly textured background. The artist's signature, "G. Lemberg," appears in the bottom right corner inside the border.
title: Punch Bowl
